rationale.deaa7d648dc88fb31b2362bd0f62f85d1eb62869: Initial authoritative runtime contract publication. The existing checked-in v2 document contains routes not present in the registered runtime surface; this decision explicitly accepts the generated runtime contract as the authoritative baseline and does not approve future breaking changes.
rationale.b7ca0f3ecdb1e6adb4fb36720cd8ddc6d5b62f7c: Approved for the current first-video production cutover. The runtime OpenAPI surface is authoritative for the deployed Forge API, and the older checked-in v2 baseline contains legacy publish, research, timeline, workflow, jobs, projects, and usage routes that are no longer registered. No external consumer migration is being performed as part of the first-video launch; future contract changes still require a new explicit approval.
